item.title: Part 12: AI Gateway Reloaded
item.description: This blog explores how Kong AI Gateway has been reloaded between versions 3.10 and 3.14, evolving from a secure AI integration layer into a powerful foundation for managing agentic AI workloads. Building on its enterprise-grade capabilities, Kong has significantly expanded its AI feature set with enhanced multi-provider support, improved resilience and fine-grained Model Context Protocol (MCP) access controls. The result is a more mature AI Gateway designed to support modern AI systems.
